about.description: A desktop client for the Juice WRLD API: albums, sessions and unreleased tracks, downloaded into a folder of your choice, with lyrics if you want them.
about.footer: An unofficial fan app, not connected to Juice WRLD's estate or label. It hosts nothing: everything comes from the API. MIT License.
about.source.desc: The catalog, the files and the lyrics. A fan project this app is not part of.
about.web.desc: LRCLIB, NetEase, Genius and lyrics.ovh, asked only when you search from Missing Lyrics.
app.name: JuiceDownloader
app.tagline: Every Juice WRLD track, one click away.

gaps.notEnabled: This uses the lyrics from the Lyrics page and writes them the same way.
gaps.search.desc: Asks LRCLIB, NetEase, Genius and lyrics.ovh. A session file looks for its session's words first and only takes the song's if it has none.
gaps.subtitle: Tracks in your folder with no words, and session files that only have the finished song's words.

library.subtitle: {0} files · {1} · {2} selected
lyrics.embed.desc: As the file's lyrics tag, which players and phones read. Other tags are left as they are, and words already there are kept.
lyrics.enable.desc: Off by default. Each song gets its words as soon as it arrives: session edits take the session's words, finished songs their own, and a file naming a version takes that version or none. Anything the API lacks goes on Missing Lyrics.
lyrics.folder.desc: For music you already have, downloaded here or not: songs without words are matched by name and get them. Words already there stay.
lyrics.folder.summary: {0} written · {1} already had them · {2} not found · {3} failed
lyrics.sidecar: Save a file beside the song
lyrics.sidecar.desc: name.lrc when the words are timed, name.txt when not. WAV, M4A and AIFF always get this, since the tag cannot be written.
lyrics.subtitle: An add-on that finds the words through the Juice WRLD API, keeping session and finished-song words apart.
lyrics.timed.desc: Lets some phone players scroll along with the song, but others show the time stamps as text.
lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.view.none: The API has no words for this one.
lyrics.view.other: These are the finished song's words: the API has none for this recording.
download.pickAlbumFolder: Choose where the album goes. A folder with its name is created inside.
overview.allUnreleased.desc: Unreleased songs, session edits, unofficial albums, compilations and remixes. No snippets, original files, beats or art.
overview.nothingSelected: Nothing selected yet. Tick a section below, or open one to choose.
overview.title: Overview
player.noBackend: To play music on Linux, install mpv.
preview.noVideo: To watch video on Linux, install mpv.
preview.title: Preview
rules.oneFolder.desc: In "{0}" inside the download folder, not scattered by era.
rules.oneVersion.desc: The most finished take: complete before unfinished, with words before without, then the better sound and the fuller take.
rules.preset.desc: Songs that never came out officially, as finished MP3s. Every session stays; every other song keeps its best version. Stems, vocals and instrumentals stay out.
rules.skipReleased: Leave out songs that came out
rules.skipReleased.desc: Demos of a song that was officially released are not unreleased music.
rules.skipUnfinished.desc: Hook only, or with nothing but an empty project.
rules.skipped: Left out: {0} other versions · {1} already released · {2} unfinished
rules.subtitle: Say what you want and get just that: finished songs, one file each.
rules.title: Download by Rules
rules.withClips.desc: Lives, snippets and bits under 45 seconds, each as it is, into a folder of their own.
section.albums.desc: What came out and is on the streaming services under Juice WRLD: albums, EPs, singles and features.
section.unofficial.desc: EPs and singles he uploaded himself, to SoundCloud and YouTube. The API calls them released; they never came out.
section.originals.desc: The files as they surfaced, MP3 and WAV, often several mixes of one song.
section.remixes.desc: Fan remixes, edits, remasters, freestyles and live recordings.
section.sessionEdits.desc: Tracks edited together from studio sessions.
section.snippets.desc: Short previews, many of them video.
section.studio.desc: Pro Tools sessions in ZIP archives. Very large: a single one can be several gigabytes.
section.unreleased.desc: Songs that never came out, by the era they were made in.
settings.confirm.desc: Shows the size, the number of files and the folder first.
settings.folder.desc: Files keep the catalog's folders inside this one.
settings.language.desc: Interface language. Auto follows your Windows display language.
settings.parallel.desc: More is faster, up to what your connection and the server allow.
settings.refreshOnLaunch.desc: At most every six hours; the last catalog opens at once either way.
settings.reset.desc: Back to the default folder, theme and language, with the lyrics add-on off. Downloaded files stay.
settings.theme.desc: Pick a theme or follow Windows.
settings.title: Settings
